subject: Hosted API onboarding call — Finly

Subject: Hosted API onboarding call — Finly

Hi Samantha,

Thanks for signing up to evaluate the Hosted API — welcome! I’m Diego with Redwood’s SDR team. Monica (cc’d) is our solutions engineer and can run a short onboarding walkthrough tailored to your use case.

Quick context: most PLG evals we do are a 30–40 minute call to cover:
- your integration goal (latency/cost targets, traffic patterns)
- a live walkthrough of the Hosted API sandbox and sample prompts
- next steps (trial credits, timeline to production)

Are you available for one of these windows (in PDT):
- Wed 2026-10-04 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-10-04 14:00–14:30
- Thu 2026-10-05 09:00–09:30

If none of those work, tell us a preferred day/time and timezone and we’ll do our best to match it. I’m attaching a short quickstart guide to help you prep.

Attachment: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (stub)

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Business Development Representative
Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Diego — thanks for the quick reach out and for the guide.

Quick note: our core team is East Coast (EDT), and the windows you proposed are a bit late for us. Could we aim for morning EDT on Thursday or Friday? Our calendar is open:
- Thu 2026-10-07 10:00–10:30 EDT
- Fri 2026-10-08 11:00–11:30 EDT

Also, we’ll need a brief overview of security compliance (SOC 2 scope) during the call — is that something Monica can cover or should we loop in security?

Thanks,
Samantha Lee
Product Lead, Finly
samantha.lee@finly.com | +1 (212) 555-0987
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@finly.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-03T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API onboarding call — Finly

Hi Samantha — great to meet you, and thanks for the availability. I can cover a concise overview of our security posture (SOC 2 controls we surface to customers plus audit artifacts) in the 30-minute session; if you need deeper security artifacts we can bring our security lead to a follow-up.

Proposed short plan for a 30-minute call (we’ll keep it focused):
- 5 min: introductions & success criteria
- 15 min: live Hosted API sandbox walkthrough (keys, example requests, streaming)
- 5 min: performance/cost levers (batching, quantization)
- 5 min: compliance & next steps (SOC 2 evidence, MFA, KMS integrations)

I’ve got the following slots in my calendar (all converted below to your EDT):
- Thu 2026-10-07 10:00–10:30 EDT (2026-10-07T14:00–14:30Z)
- Fri 2026-10-08 11:00–11:30 EDT (2026-10-08T15:00–15:30Z)

If either works, I can send a calendar invite. For convenience here are quick links:
- HubSpot meeting link: https://app.hubspot.com/meetings/monica_patel/hostedapi
- Add to calendar (Google): https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=finly-hostedapi-20261004

Attachment: calendar-invite-Finly-20261004.ics (stub)

Let me know which slot you prefer and whether you’d like the security lead on the call.

Thanks — looking forward to it,
Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0177
